682: Love for the king, good sense, and the skill to speak with carefully chosen words are three things an envoy must have.
683: An envoy who speaks for their own king's victory in front of kings armed with spears must be the most skilled scholar even among learned people.
697: Tell the king things that are useful and good for him. Never talk about useless things, even if he asks you to.
724: Share what you have learned with learned people so it reaches them. Then, from people who know even more, learn the best of what they know.
743: Books on this subject say a fort's wall needs four things: it must be high, thick, strong, and hard to reach.
753: Money is a lamp that never fails. Take it to any land you choose, and it will drive away the darkness of trouble there.
796: Even bad times have one good side. They are a measuring stick that shows how far your friends and relatives will really go for you.
